name: Aclara Resources
summary: Aclara Resources Inc. operates as a mining company primarily focused on the exploration and development of rare-earth mineral resources within Chile. The company holds extensive mining concessions, encompassing approximately 451,985 hectares, which are strategically located across the Maule, Ñuble, Biobío, and Araucanía regions of Chile. A key development undertaking for Aclara is the Penco Module, a project spanning about 600 hectares in Santiago, Chile. Established in 2021, the company also maintains its headquarters in Santiago.
